messages:
maria_sales: Quick ask 1 Globex Systems POC wants to sign the MSA + order form by end of day. They sent a redlined MSA (attached) and want SCCs, a PO field on the orderform, and a KMS attestation. Anyone available to triage?

leo_legal: On it. Can you attach their redline? I need to see which SCCs they inserted and any liability changes.

maria_sales: Attached: Globex_MSA_Redline_2026.pdf. Highlights: they replaced our DPA with their own SCCs addendum, shortened breach notice to 24 hours, and added a 30-day data deletion SLA.

jamie_procure: For the PO field, no problem. We'll add PO number + billing contact + tax id fields. Finance will want net30 by default; they requested net60.

sam_soleng: Technical note: they also asked for a per-tenant key separation attestation and a list of subprocessors for inference logs. We can provide our subprocessors list and standard key management statement. Private deployment needed for dedicated HSM.

zoe_security: We can share SOC2 Type II redacted and a completed security questionnaire (if they send it). 24-hour breach notice is tight; we'll push back to 72 hours for notification of confirmed incidents and 24 hours for initial acknowledgement.

leo_legal: Agreed on breach timing. 30-day deletion is aggressive; propose 90 days for backups, 30 days for customer-visible data. I'll draft counter redline: accept SCCs (if compatible), push 72/30 compromise, add conditional language around subprocessors (30 days' notice). Also explicitly deny unlimited liability expansion for attestation.

maria_sales: Can you paste the KMS attestation text we should offer? Globex wants language they can include in their procurement binder.

leo_legal: Draft attestation: ```
KMS Attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that customer encryption keys used in the hosted service are logically isolated per customer, managed via [Cloud KMS name], and stored in encrypted form. Redwood employs industry-standard key management controls and does not retain customer keys in plaintext. This attestation is informational and does not create additional contractual obligations.
```

sam_soleng: Add: we can state we use envelope encryption and rotate keys on a regular schedule. No mention of HSM per-tenant for hosted mode.

jamie_procure: I'll prepare the orderform template with PO field and billing block and set payment terms to net30 with a note that net60 requires finance approval.

maria_sales: Globex is pushing hard for net60. This POC could expand to $250k ARR. Can we escalate to finance?

jamie_procure: Escalating now. Tagging @finance for approval. If finance approves, we can accept net60 for >$200k deals.

zoe_security: Also ask Globex to initial any MSA changes they want to persist. That speeds negotiation.

maria_sales: Done 1 asked them to initial and re-upload. Also asked for their security questionnaire so we can answer in parallel.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood 1 Globex POC Orderform + MSA" (env: ef12ab34). Recipients: globex_signer, maria_sales, leo_legal (cc).

leo_legal: Sending counter-redline now. Key points: accept SCCs subject to standard carveouts, breach notice -> 72 hours for confirmed incidents, deletion timeline -> customer data 30 days, backups 90 days, subprocessors -> 30 days notice, attestation informational only.

maria_sales: Sent to Globex. They said procurement needs the PO on the signed orderform for their internal AP system.

jamie_procure: That's fine. They can sign and include PO number. We'll need invoice-to & remit-to on orderform. Also need vendor tax info for finance.

globex (via maria_sales): They replied: SCCs accepted with minor edits, will initial redline, prefer net60 but can accept net30 for the pilot, will escalate payment terms post-contract.

zoe_security: They uploaded the questionnaire PDF. Response ETA 2 business days.

docusign-bot: Envelope status: viewed by globex_signer at 1752468050.

leo_legal: If they initial the MSA redline and sign, we can push to finalize. I'll keep an eye for any last-minute liability edits.

jamie_procure: Finance approved net60 for this deal if it converts >$200k. Marked in the ticket.

maria_sales: Excellent. DocuSign sent; asking them to sign today. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :rocket:

docusign-bot: Envelope completed at 1752468075. Signed MSA + orderform uploaded to deals/GLOBEX/2026/attachments.

maria_sales: Signing complete 1 attaching to CRM and creating invoice request. Will follow up on SOC2 deliverable and questionnaire answers. Great work team. :tada:
